xmldoc.short_description: Pad an array before image filtering or morphology.

param_input_item.param_description: 2-D numeric/logical image or RGB image to pad.
Nonnegative integer scalar or two-element vector that specifies row and column padding.
Padding method: numeric/logical constant, replicate, symmetric or circular.
Padding direction: pre, post or both. The default value is both.

param_output_item.param_description: Padded image or array, preserving the input class.

description.p: Pad an array before image filtering or morphology. Supported padding methods include numeric constants, replicate, symmetric and circular. Direction can be pre, post or both. Text options are case-insensitive.
